If f(x,y)=e2y−x,x=cos⁡t and y=sin⁡t, compute dfdt.

a
(sin⁡t+2cos⁡t)e2sin⁡t−cos⁡t
b
(2sin⁡tcos⁡t+1)e2sin⁡t−cos⁡t
c
e2sin⁡t−cos⁡t
d
2e2sin⁡t−cos⁡t
e
(2sin⁡t−cos⁡t)e2sin⁡t−cos⁡t
